name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
summary: An upper-body compound press performed on an inclined bench using a guided barbell track to target the upper chest, front deltoids, and triceps.

aliases.text: Smith Machine Low Incline Bench Press

setup: Position an adjustable bench at a 15- to 30-degree incline directly centered beneath the Smith machine bar.
Lie back on the bench so the bar aligns directly over your upper chest when lowered.
Set your feet flat on the floor, retract and depress your shoulder blades into the bench pad, and grasp the bar slightly outside shoulder width with a pronated grip.
Rotate the bar off the safety hooks and hold it with arms extended over your upper chest.
steps: Lower the bar under control toward your upper chest, just below the clavicles, keeping your elbows tucked at roughly 45 to 60 degrees from your torso.
Touch lightly or pause just above the chest without bouncing.
Press the bar upward in the fixed path until your elbows are extended without unlocking your shoulder blades from the bench.
At the end of the set, rotate your wrists to engage the safety catches onto the nearest rack pins.
instructions.breathing: Inhale as you lower the bar to your chest, brace your core, and exhale forcefully as you press past the sticking point.
cues: Pin your shoulder blades back and down.
Drive your feet through the floor.
Squeeze your chest together as you press.

common_faults.fault: Bench placed too far forward or backward, forcing unnatural wrist or shoulder angles.
common_faults.correction: Align the bench so the bar naturally descends directly to the upper chest without crowding the neck or stomach.

common_faults.fault: Flaring elbows out at 90 degrees to the torso.
common_faults.correction: Tuck your elbows to roughly 45 to 60 degrees to protect the shoulder joint and maintain upper-chest leverage.

common_faults.fault: Bouncing the bar off the sternum.
common_faults.correction: Control the eccentric descent and maintain continuous muscular tension throughout the turnaround.

precautions: Ensure the Smith machine safety stoppers are set just below chest height before loading heavy weights.
